run_prepare_pascal_context: run the script to convert PASCAL Context validation masks from .mat to .tif and .png formats
convert_pc59_mask: convert a PASCAL Context .mat mask file to a 59-class PNG using a label mapping dictionary
convert_pc459_mask: convert a PASCAL Context .mat mask file to a 459-class TIFF by subtracting one from labels
review_convert_pc59: review the convert_pc59 function that maps 459-class labels to 59-class labels and saves as PNG
summarize_convert_pc459: summarize the convert_pc459 function that loads a .mat LabelMap, decrements labels, and saves as TIFF
